title: SVD-Attention: Efficiently Analyzing Attention Blocks in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.34971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained transformers spend a large share of their inference compute inside self-attention, yet the per-head query-key interaction is structurally low-rank by construction. We ask a diagnostic question: across layers and architectures, which heads actually use the full rank budget on real data, and which do not? We propose SVD-Attention, a post-hoc method that decomposes the per-head interaction matrix $M_h$ and scores every singular mode by both its spectral magnitude and its activation variance across tokens on a small calibration set. The score keeps the modes the head can amplify and that real data actually activates, and discards the rest; the resulting factorization is exact for the retained modes and needs no finetuning. translated_title: SVD-注意力：高效分析Transformer中的注意力模块
translated_abstract: 预训练Transformer在自注意力上花费了大量推理计算，而每个注意力头的查询-键交互在结构上天生是低秩的。我们提出一个诊断性问题：在不同层和不同架构中，哪些头在真实数据上真正用满了秩预算，哪些没有？我们提出SVD-Attention，这是一种事后（post-hoc）方法，它对每个注意力头的交互矩阵 $M_h$ 进行分解，并根据每个奇异模式的谱幅值以及其在小校准集上跨token的激活方差来为模式评分。该评分保留头能够放大且真实数据确实会激活的模式，并丢弃其余模式；所得分解对于保留的模式是精确的，且无需微调。在七个预训练模型和五种任务类型上，该诊断发现了任务相关的模式：对于情感分类、图像分类和生成任务，冗余集中在早期到中间层……
tldr: 该论文提出SVD-Attention——一种无需微调的事后诊断方法，通过谱幅值与激活方差对每个注意力头的奇异模式评分，精确识别哪些头真正用满秩预算，并揭示了注意力冗余随任务类型和层深分布的规律。
en_tdlr: SVD-Attention is a finetuning-free post-hoc method that scores each singular mode of per-head attention interaction matrices by spectral magnitude and activation variance, exactly identifying which heads use their full rank budget on real data and revealing task-dependent patterns of attention redundancy across layers.
